scenarios.name: Search the Model tree from another active dock tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-points.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Model and Log occupy one dock tab bar with Log active
the Model search field is closed
the user clicks the search icon in that dock tab bar
Model becomes active and its empty search field has keyboard focus
the Find criteria dialog remains closed
the user types "InspectionPoint" without clicking another control
the Model tree shows InspectionPointA, InspectionPointB and InspectionPointC
the query is highlighted in the matching tree rows
the user switches to Log and clicks the dock tab bar search icon again
Model becomes active with "InspectionPoint" still in the focused search field
